forms: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,3)>Hey! Hey, <$cdef(27)>Serperior</color>! How’d you get so BIG?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Well now, let me think... Perhaps it’s because I make sure
to eat a variety of different foods.
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Ohhh, OK! Then I’m gonna eat lotsa different foods, too!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,4)>You know, if you really want to grow big, exercise and rest
are important as well.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>Um, OK, so, um... I gotta eat healthy food and do regular
exercise <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>and...and sleep a whole lot...

<$comcan(1)><$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,10)>It’s not just about sleeping a lot—it helps to go to sleep
and wake up early. As for exercise, I stretch before I
work out my vines and—

<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)>Whoa! Ahhhhhh... That’s so much stuff. Where do I
even START?!

<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,14)>Oh dear, was that too complicated? Forgive me, little one.
Let’s see... <$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)>How about regularly basking in the sun?
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>“Bask-ing?”

<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,6)>In other words, relaxing in the sunlight. It’s needed for
photosynthesis, after all.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)>Ohhh! I get it! Yeah, that’s definitely something
I can do! <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>Thanks so much, <$cdef(27)>Serperior!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Yooo, <$cdef(27)>Conkeldurr! You’re always carryin’ around that
concrete, right? <$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Doesn’t it get heavy?

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>Nawww. Ya jus’ gotta train fer it! Become one with the
concrete ’n’ use it to get stronger!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,817)>Every mornin’, I wake up ’n’ do about 500 or so concrete
swings, and every night before I hit the hay, I do about
1,000 concrete lifts!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>And when I’m sleepin’, I’m dreamin’ of concrete! At this
point, it’s basically an extension of these ol’ arms of mine!

<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,4)>Uh... Wow. That’s pretty cool, but, uh...I dunno if it’s
somethin’ I’m interested in doing myself!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>Them muscles o’ yers are kinda puny-lookin’, <$cdef(27)>Frogadier!
Do they give ya the power ya need in a battle?

<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,827)><$comeff(2,14)>It’s true that my muscles aren’t super strong like yours...
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,5)>But that’s OK ’cause I’m super fast!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,20)>Aha! So what you’re sayin’ is, you’ve still got room to get
super strong ’n’ become a double threat!
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)>I, uh...huh? I dunno if I like where this is goin’, yo...

<$voicel(1,10)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Yes indeed! I do believe it is time fer a li’l trainin’!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,9)>Here, I’ll lend ya my concrete! Doin’ a hundred swings or
so oughta start ya off right, I reckon!
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,4)>Aggghhh! Yooo, no way!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Froakie! I heard you played with my <$cdef(27)>Dreepy today!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,10)>Thanks for that, yo!
Thanks, yo!
<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,9)>No biggie! I had tons of fun chasing <$cdef(27)>Dreepy</color> around!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Yo, I was super surprised to hear <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,8)>that you caught <$cdef(27)>Dreepy</color>!
I thought <$cdef(27)>Froakie</color> was spacing out, so I dropped my guard!

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Shucks, I just got lucky! <$cdef(27)>Dreepy was zipping around so fast
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>I couldn’t keep up with them at all!

<$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Awww snap. I bet you’re just pretendin’ to be humble right
now <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)>to get us to let our guards down for next time!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>You think so? Hehe!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Ohhhh, you’re a tricky one for sure, yo!

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>I’ve been meaning to ask for a while now, dear, but that
long thing you’ve got there... <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>Is that your tongue?
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,8)>Indeed, it is.

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>So, you’ve got your tongue wrapped around your neck?
Why would you do that?

<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)>My tongue is extremely sensitive. With it, I can sense any
presence in my vicinity.
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>For example, I can tell whether someone is hiding behind
a wall.
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, my! How very useful! I think I’ll give it a whirl myself.
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh? Do you have abilities similar to mine?

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>I couldn’t tell you, but who knows—maybe I’ll sense
something!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>All right, here I go!
<$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,7)>*bleeeh*
...Hmm... I’ll give it another go.
<$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,6)>*bleeeh*
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Well? Do you sense an unseen presence?

<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,7)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,4)>Hmmm... Aha!
<$comeff(2,20)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Yes, I feel something! I feel...thirsty!
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>Your sensation of thirst is not an unseen presence...
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>Ugh... GRRR! This is the worst!
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>What’s the matter?

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Corvisquire! Your timing is TOTALLY perfect!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>The back of my neck is itching like crazy, and there’s not
a thing I can do about it on my own!
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>You want me to scratch it, yeah? Fine, I guess... <wait(0.5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,8)>Hup!

<$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>Ack, no, not there! You gotta scratch a little more to the
right! TO THE RIGHT!
<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,4)>Over here? <wait(0.4)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,6)>Hup! <wait(0.8)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,8)>Hyah!
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>You’re SO close! Just a little more to the left!
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,4)>What? You mean here? <wait(0.4)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,8)>Hah!
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Yeah, that’s the spot! Just give it a big ol’ scratch!

<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,6)>What’ve I gotten myself into?
<$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,4)>Hm, maybe if I crank up the speed... <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,6)>Hyah! <$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,8)>Hyah! <$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,10)>HYAH!
<$emotion(1,58)><$voicel(1,4)>*pant* *wheeze*

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>PHEEEW! What a RELIEF! You are a total lifesaver! Here!
Take this for your trouble!
<$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,3)>A single berry? After all that scratching?
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Darn... I can’t find anything anywhere.
<$comcan(2)><$lookat(1,0,2)><$lookat(2,0,1)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,6)>Oh hello, <$cdef(27)>Tinkatink</color>. Are you searching for something?

<$voicel(2,4)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,807)>I’m looking for stuff to make my hammer with...
... ... ...
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,40)>Oh!
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,38)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Corviknight, didja know you are SO COOL-looking?!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>Hm? Oh, err, yes. I see you have an eye for quality,
<$cdef(27)>Tinkatink.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,6)>With that really neat color and hard body... SUPER cool!

<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,21)>Heh heh. Why yes, I do have a rather beautiful glossy
finish, and these feathers are quite sturdy indeed.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)>They provide excellent protection.

<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,814)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Yeah, exactly! Super sturdy and perfect for smashing
stuff with!

<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Indeed, even if I were to be smashed by— <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,6)>Wait, did you
say perfect FOR smashing?

<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,1)>Yayyy, I’m so glad I finally found what I was looking for!
I’m gonna make the coolest, bestest hammer!
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Now how many feathers should I take? Hmm...

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)>Errr... You know, I just remembered an urgent matter that
requires my attention, so...I’ll be going now.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Hiya! Didja fire any of your head missiles today?

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,3)>Naw. It’s jus’ so peaceful round these parts, y’know?
Not much reason to fire off these young’uns.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,17)>Awww... Then it’s NEVER gonna be my turn...
<$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>You wanna get launched that badly, huh?
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,8)>Yeah! I wanna shoot through the air and go WHEEE!

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,10)>Ya never know whatcha might find when ya touch down,
though. Could be a battle with a dangerous opponent!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,6)>But if I don’t get into those fights, how am I ever gonna
get as strong as you?

<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,14)>Hmmm. Yep, that’s a good point there.
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>I always figured lastin’ peace was a good thing...
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,806)>But now I reckon that might rob us of opportunities to
get stronger!
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>Yeah, yeah. Less talking, more launching!

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,1)><$motion(2,803)>Hi there, <$cdef(27)>Drakloak! You look like you’re working hard
like always!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>Hey! You’re a pretty hard worker yourself, <$cdef(27)>Tinkatink! It’s
super cool to see from someone who’s <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>still so little!
<$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)>Kinda jealous to be honest, yo. My li’l one doesn’t do
much of anything!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Aw, thanks! But I’ve only just begun to learn and ma-chure!

<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,7)><$textsize(2)>That’s...so...CUTE!!!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)>Yooo, you’re makin’ me feel parenty feelings, and I’m not
even your parent?! Wanna join the fam? It’ll be great! <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>I bet
my li’l one would love it too!

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,5)>No way, I wanna be an independent grown-up real soon!
But thanks for asking!

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Wooow. You really are a mature li’l Pokémon!
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>I just can’t help but worry about ya goin’ through life all
alone, though! <$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)>Maybe if you had a teacher or somethin’?!

<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Don’t worry! I’ll be OK ’cause I’ve got this hammer!
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,814)><$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,7)>Graaahhh!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>WHOA! That’s a pretty cool hammer! It’s kinda little but
seems to be really well-made!
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,39)>Hee hee! I made it all by myself!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>Seriously?! Yooo! You can make stuff, and you’re strong
and... Huh... You might be more of a grown-up than me!
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>Guess I don’t need to worry about you after all! I’m sure
you’ll grow and mature just fine, <$cdef(27)>Tinkatink!
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,10)>Yeah! And good luck with your li’l guy, too, <$cdef(27)>Drakloak</color>!
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,6)>Your fur looks so fluffy, <$cdef(27)>Sprigatito</color>! Mind if I touch it?
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>Yeah, that’s fine. Just don’t make it tickle, OK?

<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,9)>OK, got it! I won’t make it ticklish.
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,10)>Hah!
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>Gah!

<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,4)>Wooow... It’s so curly and fluffy...and so super SOFT! <$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,49)>It’s
amazing!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)>Oh, come on! If you’re gonna do that, then I guess I’ll
just... <$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,10)>Yah!
<$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)>Whoa!

<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,14)>...Huh?
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,6)>You’re kinda moist and smooth...and doughy and soft...
So nice to the touch!

<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,9)>Hehehe... Your paws are so squishy too, Sprigatito...
It’s neat how we’ve got all these different textures! ♪

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Yeah... There’s so many kinds, and I wanna feel them all!
<$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)><$lookat(2,0,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, hi, <$cdef(27)>!

<$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)>Since we’re already on a roll, let’s see what textures
<$cdef(27)>’s
got
going on!
<$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)>Hah!<$comeff(0,5)><$facial(0,13)><$motion(0,182)>
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>*squish squish*... This is fun!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)><$pkcry;0(2,2)>! ♪ Fluffy, curly, soft, and squishy... ♪
<$voicel(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,8)>We got to experience so many different textures today!
How wonderful!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,10)>*flop flop flop flop flop* Phew! Guess that’s enough
exercise for today!
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,3)>What? That’s not even close to your highest potential.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)>Huh? I dunno what you think you know about me, but this
is definitely all I got, yo.
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,21)>I bet you can flop much, MUCH higher than that.
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,14)><$motion(1,803)>No wayyy! It’d be dangerous for me to flop up too high!

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>Come on, just think about all the grueling battles you’ve
endured up until now.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$comcan(2)>Uh... I’ve never battled, yo.

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>OK, forget that. The point is you’re the type of <$cdef(27)>Magikarp
who could always be striving for greater heights.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)>You really think so? Well, I guess I can try to flop just a li’l
bit higher... <$motion(1,814)>*flop FLOP*
<$voicel(1,1)><$comeff(1,11)>Ow! Yooo...I think my abs are crampin’... <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,7)>Maybe changin’
things up isn’t really a good idea after all!

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,859)><$facial(2,4)>Don’t worry. After a little Thunder Shock therapy, your
muscles will feel—

<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)>No, no, no! Nope! I’m totally fine! Everything’s gonna be
just fine! I think I’m already fine, actually!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,6)>You’re so warm, <$cdef(27)>Torchic! I feel all toasty just hanging out
with you!

<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,60)>I know, right?!
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,9)>A lotta the time in the winter, when I wake up in the
morning, tons of Pokémon are all around me!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>Wow, other Pokémon must love you! I wish I was that
popular...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,8)>If only I could become a warm Pokémon like you, <$cdef(27)>Torchic.

<$voicel(2,3)><$motionoff(2,817)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,2)>Oh, but in the summer, nobody wants to be close to me at
all. It’s super lonely!

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, really? Then I guess I wanna be <$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>a Pokémon who’s
warm in the winter but cool in the summer!
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,33)>...But how do I do that?

<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,13)>Umm... I dunno.
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,48)>But I think it’d probably be more awesome if you just
picked something and stuck with it!
<$voicel(1,2)><$emotion(1,5)>You think?! Oh, man—picking one thing is so hard...

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>Y’know, I’ve been thinking a lot these days... It’d be so
nice if I could stay like this forever!
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,663)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>Becoming a grown-up seems kinda scary...

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Whatever do you mean? Aren’t you excited to see how
you’ll grow and change?

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,10)><$comeff(1,4)>B-but what if I’m having the most fun I’ll ever have right
now? I dunno what’s gonna happen in the future...

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,3)>Shall I let you in on a little secret?
<$voicel(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)>There was once a time when I dreamt of looking ”cooler.“
<$voicel(2,6)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)>I wanted sharp, spiky fur, or a coat as black as night.
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>Really? You mean you don’t like how you are now?

<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,14)>Oh, I don’t mean that at all! My feelings simply changed
after spending time with a human I care about deeply.
